entries.title: A panel's card on your iPhone or iPad stays up to date
entries.body: A card a panel puts up on Home now follows your computer while it shows, as it does on your computer: when the tasks or the panel's own data it shows change, the card shows the change. Before, it kept what it first read until it was shown again.
entries.noPicture: The card looks as it did; it now changes while it shows, which a still picture cannot show.
